description: AI Pattern Database for PineScript Debugging

common_errors.name: Series Index Out of Bounds
common_errors.fix: Add boundary check: if bar_index >= length then ...

common_errors.name: Division by Zero
common_errors.description: Potential division by zero or na
common_errors.fix: Add zero check: denominator != 0 ? numerator / denominator : na

common_errors.name: Na Propagation
common_errors.fix: Use nz() function to handle na values

common_errors.name: Infinite Loop Risk
common_errors.description: For loop with potential infinite iteration
common_errors.fix: Add max iteration limit or validate step direction
common_errors.example_fixed: if step > 0 then for i = start to stop by step do

common_errors.name: Uninitialized Variables
common_errors.description: Variables initialized to na without proper setup
common_errors.fix: Initialize with default value or add initialization logic

performance_issues.name: Redundant Calculations
performance_issues.fix: Store result in variable and reuse
performance_issues.example_fixed:
sma14 = ta.sma(close, 14)
sma1 = sma14
sma2 = sma14

performance_issues.name: Inefficient Array Operations
performance_issues.description: Array operations on every bar causing performance hit
performance_issues.fix: Use series operations or limit array updates

performance_issues.name: Excessive Plot Calls
performance_issues.description: Too many plot calls affecting rendering performance
performance_issues.fix: Combine plots or use plotshape/plotchar for multiple items

performance_issues.name: Unoptimized Loops
performance_issues.description: Large loops in PineScript (limited to 500ms execution)
performance_issues.fix: Reduce loop size or use built-in functions
performance_issues.example_bad: for i = 0 to 1000 do sum := sum + close[i]

best_practices.name: Memory Optimization
best_practices.fix: Use dynamic sizing or smaller arrays

best_practices.name: Error Handling
best_practices.description: Missing error handling for risky operations

best_practices.name: Code Organization
best_practices.example_bad: 100 lines of code in main scope

tradingview_specific.name: Security Function Misuse
tradingview_specific.fix: Cache security results or call conditionally
tradingview_specific.example_fixed:
var higherTFClose = na
if barstate.islastconfirmedhistory
    higherTFClose := security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", close)

tradingview_specific.name: Repainting Issues
tradingview_specific.fix: Use barstate.isconfirmed or historical data only

tradingview_specific.name: Indicator Overload
tradingview_specific.fix: Combine indicators or use custom calculations
